response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT f.film_id, COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS cnt FROM film f LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id), avg1 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS a1 FROM counts), s1 AS (SELECT c.film_id, c.cnt, c.cnt - a.a1 AS ex1 FROM counts c CROSS JOIN avg1 a WHERE c.cnt > a.a1), avg2 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS a2 FROM s1), s2 AS (SELECT s1.film_id, s1.cnt, s1.ex1, s1.cnt - b.a2 AS ex2 FROM s1 CROSS JOIN avg2 b WHERE s1.cnt > b.a2) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_actors, AVG(ex1) AS avg_excess_first, AVG(ex2) AS avg_excess_second FROM s2
